text: Completed and verified the concrete saved-study slice: StudyPlan with typed parameters/results, method/layout identities, content references, structural equality/diffs and prerequisite checks; pure interpreter reuses scientific operations; VersionedCodec and StudyCodec provide versioned envelopes, conditional key/parameter codecs, duplicate-key-rejecting entry arrays and cast-free captured registration. Nine portable codec tests plus published laws and the isolated downstream consumer pass. Pinned v1 meaning, exact restored results and cross-runtime output are verified. New CodecLaws caught two deliberate string-encoder failures; uniform-for-duration weighting caught three scientific failures; original bytes restored. Shared Grid constructor now rejects overflowing cell counts, with portable regressions. Full 2,034 tests and required gates pass. See docs/SAVED_STUDIES.md and PARITY.md. This broader seam issue remains open for the conditional Trials[K,M,A]/Timeline[A] contracts and general node-family coverage in its original body; this slice does not silently mark those complete. Releasing the completed study work and path reservations.
